name: se
description: Turn ideas into clear Feature plans, deliver them through reviewed pull requests, maintain project knowledge, and audit active work.

interface.shortDescription: Plan Features, deliver reviewed pull requests, and maintain project knowledge.
interface.longDescription: SE supports a complete software-delivery workflow. Learn maintains durable project knowledge and decisions. Idea captures proposals for later planning. Feature turns one or more source issues into an evidence-backed Feature Plan Set, classifies planning depth, requires a consolidated product-question batch for substantial work unless a validated exception applies, uses delegated study and critic lenses when available, independently reviews every complete plan before validation with bounded revision and follow-up clarification, creates separate Feature issues and practical Macro Tasks, preserves repository-sensitive dependency intent, publishes mandatory best-effort native GitHub dependency projections backed by authoritative body relations, and delegates optional label and native type classification to G during publication. Implement selects Features only from caller-supplied GitHub issue references, never from labels or Issue Types. A fresh Implement run creates one observable user-owned orchestrator task plus one observable user-owned Worker task per Feature; a validated resume reuses only those exact bound task identities. Saved-project routing and visibility do not gate those roles, which never fall back to subordinate in-task delegation or replacement tasks. Implement treats each parent Feature as the required semantic contract, treats native dependency state as non-blocking diagnostics, tolerates and reports partial or absent Macro Task projections, derives technical T-AC criteria without weakening F-AC, loads role- and phase-specific contracts, conditionally consolidates material pre-candidate risks before complete validation, accepts an optional starting branch per target repository, refreshes and freezes its exact upstream tip before root Feature Worker worktrees start, delivers each Feature through a dedicated resumable Worker that owns each phase to a semantic boundary, publishes concise durable PR bodies, starts stacked children from verified candidate-published parents, centrally monitors pull requests, CI, review feedback, and exact-head stack state through material-delta observations and actionable-frontier scheduling, and leaves merge and post-merge closure to the user. Audit observes active SE work and reports problems or workflow improvements without making changes.
defaultPrompt: Use $se:learn to maintain durable repository knowledge, or $se:idea to save a proposal for later planning.
Use $se:feature to turn related requests into Feature issues and Macro Tasks without writing code.
Use $se:implement to deliver a planned Feature through observable user-owned tasks and reviewed pull requests.
